name: Size Sieve
description: Open a multi-size knitting or crochet pattern and read it with only your size's numbers, with anything it can't resolve flagged; nothing leaves your device.
problem: Knitting and crochet patterns print every size's numbers side by side, as in "cast on 80 (88, 96, 104) sts", so knitters go through the whole pattern with a highlighter before starting and still misread strings of numbers mid-project.
